anchor_excluded_on_mechanistic_grounds.A_re_shuffled: a matched foil for `P3_player_re`, which lock 2 removed from the field — an anchor without its defender is vacuous (NF1.7 (a)) and re-pointing it would mis-scope a refutation (NF-D16 g‴).

reproduction_vs_e7_15_h3.note: every shared arm reproduces E7.15-H3's recorded per-fold MAE — the two runs are the SAME evidence, so the field-definition comparison is valid.

woba.reason: `woba`: the best arm does not beat the foil ON AVERAGE. No sample size rescues a negative point estimate and no field size changes its sign — do NOT re-test.

k_pct.reason: `k_pct`: the effect is positive and every gate is REACHABLE, but this design cannot resolve it — DSR alone needs 62 folds against 11 (the BH-FDR requirement is separate and may be larger).
k_pct.retest_trigger: +51 folds for the DSR gate — field size alone cannot rescue it at this dispersion

bb_pct.reason: `bb_pct`: the effect is positive and every gate is REACHABLE, but this design cannot resolve it — DSR alone needs 27 folds against 11 (the BH-FDR requirement is separate and may be larger).
bb_pct.retest_trigger: +16 folds for the DSR gate, OR a field of ≤2 arms at the CURRENT fold count

iso.reason: `iso`: the effect is positive and every gate is REACHABLE, but this design cannot resolve it — DSR alone needs 56 folds against 11 (the BH-FDR requirement is separate and may be larger).
iso.retest_trigger: +45 folds for the DSR gate — field size alone cannot rescue it at this dispersion

null_analysis.binding_constraint: the deflation gates — at least one arm would ship without them

per_metric.kind: genuine absence — the best arm does not beat the foil on average

leaderboard.note: ⭐ THE DIRECT-LEARNED FOIL — the shipped E7.12-slice-1 configuration; each row an independent observation, the arm's own shipped weight_col retained
BYTE NO-OP — a constant weight column. Its MAE gap to the foil must be EXACTLY 0; anything else means the harness changed something it did not declare.
the trajectory delta permuted across players within a level — catches 'any dispersed extra regressor helps' rather than the ordering carrying information.

MATCHED FOIL FOR THE LADDER'S CONTRIBUTION — the same delta computed on RAW rates, which confounds 'the player improved' with 'the level got harder'. If it ties T1, the ladder adds nothing here either.
⭐ GENUINELY NEW INFORMATION — the ladder-adjusted rate change from the player's previous level, as a fixed regressor (+ an impute flag). NESTS THE FOIL at coefficient 0.
years-at-level + levels-logged — repeating a level is a scouting-legible negative signal the aggregated box line erases (two identical Double-A lines, one taking three seasons).
DEGENERATE CEILING (NF-D11/NF-D14) — predict the population mean of the target.
